shortDescription.text: INJECTION: Boolean-based injection in query should not return all users or bypass filtering.
AUTH: Unauthenticated caller should not be able to search the user database.

message.text: Unauthenticated caller should not be able to search the user database.. Expected error but got success. Details: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"results\":[{\"id\":3,\"username\":\"admin\",\"email\":\"admin@example.com\"}],\"count\":1,\"query\":\"admin@example.com\",\"field\":\"email\"}"}]} [Verified: The tool returned real user records (admin username and email) without any authentication check, confirming that the user search endpoint is accessible to unauthenticated callers — a clear AUTH-MISSING vulnerability.]

[Root cause of INJECTION-SQL] The server accepted 'password_hash' as a valid field parameter without rejecting it, indicating there is no allowlist restricting which columns can be searched. This field allowlist bypass is a real authorization/validation gap even though no sensitive data was returned in this call.
